archive_layout: Each volume is an ordinary ZIP below100MiB. Extract every volume into one directory. repo-relative entries preserve source, logs, raw vectors and receipts; no model/SDK copies.
implementation: Private consumer turn/cohort waves; at most one dependency-ready call per Session. Resolve all previous-prefix lookups before stable equal actualT/kind buckets; zero-row full hits do not submit Graph. No padding.
One original Model.prepare/submit/finish batch and one Invocation/Completion per bucket. All independent KV/conv/GDN and decisions published together via the previously verified core episode.

CachePlan receives realR; N committed versions plus at mostR candidate state blocks/COW tails. Before commit requireL+R-D<=N whereD counts truly disappearing distinct selected bases after all external Session/directory owners. Recompute after every actual prefix eviction.

Cold wave/suffix shape domains and conservative per-slot replay use bounds precede carriers. Single off mode preserves exact ordered slot use/preparation. Only actual selected children/slots initialized.
Global Graph calls count batches once. PerSession graph_participations are separate. Physical batches, logical dispatch and overlapping wave walls are reported independently.

Eviction rebuild recomputes original actual input chunks, never resamples/changes already returned history. New realhead.next_id is not overwritten. Imported history rebuild creates new ReplayHistory with real recomputed nexts and leaves old shared history untouched. Exact snapshot reuse and recompute are different contracts.

limits: Batch-size changes can alter legal BF16 reductions. Greedy mismatches are reported, never filtered or promoted to quality acceptance.

ready_baseline.definition: Last process-running sample between received ready and earliest actual prefill-begin; null when none exists.

limits: All boundaries are parent receipt times from live stderr, not exact device/allocator times. Phase names are discovered from actual markers, including session prefixes.
Missing/duplicate/reversed boundaries have no derived phase values; short/full-hit phases may have zero samples. Null bytes remain null, never zero-filled.
PSAPI/PDH sampled maxima are lower bounds, not physical allocation totals. Dedicated/shared separate maxima must not be added; total uses simultaneous available counters.
Neighbor-sample phase deltas include bracket age and may include subsequent work or teardown; they do not attribute allocations or frees.
Old runs whose observer dropped session-prefixed markers cannot have timestamped phase samples reconstructed from untimestamped stderr. This adapter does not rewrite them.
Memory sampling is independent and never contributes to unmonitored timing denominators.

comparison_limits.source_checkpoint: Same original Qwen3.5-2B checkpoint; 320 text tensors, no MTP/vision or low-bit quantization.
comparison_limits.representations: Hyle reads original Safetensors BF16/F32; retained peer GGUF has187BF16+133F32, including97 original BF16 small tensors promoted to F32. Prior audit checked all F32 exception values/name/shape/type mapping. This review does not rehash multi-GB weights.
comparison_limits.intermediate_math: Actual full model and tokens are comparable, but intermediate evaluation is not bit-identical: Hyle conv history BF16/GDN F32 (main.cc183-194), peer original recurrent R/S F32. BF16 KV on both. Equal198 IDs here does not establish cross-B or cross-engine tensor tolerance/quality.
comparison_limits.capacities: Logical C1024,N2,R2 for batch/peer. Hyle serial candidate capacityN+1 vs batchN+2 is intentional. HyleR1 backing83,976,240B; HyleB2 backing103,710,768B (130x16 physical KV rows=2080); peer KV+RS105,971,712B/native2048-token pool/native IDs4. Peer native_n_ctx_seq2048 is an allocation ability; common input remains864 tokens/session and logical cap1024.
comparison_limits.failure_contract: Hyle retains bounded immutable snapshot candidates and whole-batch atomic completion/abort. Peer may update unretained native sequence versions in place (zero seq_cp observed here); benchmark does not equate their failure/cancel contracts.
